title: Hold On (the night is young)
style: English, upbeat pop rock, bright female vocal, electric guitar, bass, punchy drums, catchy chorus, 118 BPM
lyrics:
[Verse]
Streetlights hum a song I used to know
Every window glowing soft and low
I keep walking where the river bends
Counting all the roads that never end

[Chorus]
Hold on, hold on, the night is young
Every heartbeat is a song unsung
Turn it up and let the city ring
We were born to find a reason to sing

[Verse]
Paper tickets folded in my hand
Half a map and half a better plan
If the morning finds us far from home
We will build a place to call our own

[Chorus]
Hold on, hold on, the night is young
Every heartbeat is a song unsung
Turn it up and let the city ring
We were born to find a reason to sing

[Bridge]
When the lights go down
And the crowd goes quiet
I will hear you still
In the heart of the riot

[Chorus]
Hold on, hold on, the night is young
Every heartbeat is a song unsung
Turn it up and let the city ring
We were born to find a reason to sing
note: English pop rock with the lyrics from songforge bench.

title: Carry Me Home
style: English, acoustic folk, warm male vocal, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft cello, intimate, 84 BPM
lyrics:
[Verse]
Paper lanterns on the water
Every light a little prayer
Mother humming to her daughter
Summer thunder in the air

[Chorus]
Carry me home on the river
Carry me home on the tide
Whatever the years deliver
I will have you by my side

[Verse]
Fireflies above the reeds now
Writing letters in the dark
Every wish is all we need now
Every ember is a spark

[Chorus]
Carry me home on the river
Carry me home on the tide
Whatever the years deliver
I will have you by my side

title: Jingle Bells (heavy metal cover)
style: heavy metal, distorted guitars, double-kick drums, powerful male vocal, high energy, 160 BPM
lyrics:
[Verse]
Dashing through the snow
In a one-horse open sleigh
O'er the fields we go
Laughing all the way
Bells on bobtail ring
Making spirits bright
What fun it is to ride and sing
A sleighing song tonight

[Chorus]
Jingle bells, jingle bells
Jingle all the way
Oh what fun it is to ride
In a one-horse open sleigh
Jingle bells, jingle bells
Jingle all the way
Oh what fun it is to ride
In a one-horse open sleigh

Should old acquaintance be forgot

Should old acquaintance be forgot

For auld lang syne, my dear
For auld lang syne
We'll take a cup of kindness yet
For auld lang syne
